courses.name: Arithmetic
courses.blurb: Place value, the four operations, fractions, decimals, percentages, order of operations, integers and ratios.

courses.name: Algebra
courses.blurb: Expressions, linear equations and inequalities, lines, systems, polynomials, factoring and quadratics.

courses.name: Trigonometry
courses.blurb: Angles, right triangles, the unit circle, sine and cosine graphs, identities and solving triangles.

courses.name: Calculus
courses.blurb: Limits, derivatives, product and chain rules, applications, integrals as area and the Fundamental Theorem.

courses.name: Linear algebra
courses.blurb: Vectors, matrices, systems Ax=b, determinants, eigenvalues and linear maps in the plane.

courses.name: Topology
courses.blurb: Open and closed sets, continuity, homeomorphisms, connectedness, compactness, and examples on R and the circle.
